user.title: Read-only finance collector
user.description: Confirm the cumulative Sigenergy sources. This starts durable collection only, not financial calculations or energy control. Configure missing verified inputs in the integration's Configure menu after setup. Values are not backfilled from daily mySigen generation.

menu_options.live_settings: Live reserve and observed power settings (read-only)
menu_options.activate_export: Activate Flux export — confirmation date and time

live_settings.title: Read-only reserve and limits
live_settings.description:
Current HA reserve: {reserve}%. Unknown/unavailable never fall back to a saved 50%. Settings observations below are dated; a configured U32 all-ones sentinel is NOT a power limit. Capabilities/ratings are distinct from configured settings. No energy controls are written.

{settings}

schedule_model.title: Versioned schedule model — not an AI performance claim
schedule_model.description: Explicit estimated AC end-use model; policy timing is unchanged. Inclusive-load correction applies to BOTH baseline and schedule on identical covered segments. Calibration is retrospective. PV factor 1 is an optimistic assumption; sensitivities are illustrative, not measured confidence limits. Grid headroom remains unknown when its register is invalid. Historical hardware applicability is an assumption. Edits append a model version; no old samples or reports are removed. These settings override legacy physical fields in Baseline evidence; actual reserve always comes from dated observations, never a fixed option. No energy controls are written.

tariff_history.title: Separate import/export histories
tariff_history.description: Configure your own verified dated sources and evidence. Exported defaults are synthetic examples, not installation evidence.

edit_tariff.title: Correct tariff date/rates
edit_tariff.description: Date AND time are Europe/London. A correction replaces this record prospectively or retrospectively in calculations, retaining the old audit version. Currency units are explicit. For Flexible import only the standard rate is used. Keep Assumed enabled unless dates/rates are confirmed; record evidence. This does NOT change the supplier tariff or inverter.

data.standard_rate: Other-times rate per kWh (Flexible: all hours)
data.currency_unit: Rate currency unit — GBP or pence
data.assumed: Effective date/rates are assumed, not billing verified
data.evidence: Confirmation reference or explicit assumption provenance

activate_export.title: Activate Flux export
activate_export.description: Only submit after confirmation. Set the actual effective date AND time, including a retrospective date if required. No automatic waiting period. Initial rates GBP/kWh: 02–05 0.0434; 16–19 0.2770; other 0.0976; standing 0. Does not change import history, supplier account or energy controls. Enter a dated confirmation reference; use Assumed only if explicitly authorized.

data.currency_unit: Rate currency unit — GBP or pence
data.assumed: Effective date/rates are assumed, not billing verified

evidence.title: Verified evidence, not assumed defaults
evidence.description: Baseline tariff and meter-boundary evidence. See Live settings for ACTUAL reserve (not the legacy fixed option below). See Estimated schedule model for the versioned physical scenario: it overrides legacy capacity/loss/power fields here. The live reserve is never backfilled from a saved option. No controls are written.

data.boundary_verified: All three meters exclude Hypervolt consistently — verified
data.effective_from: Evidence valid from (RFC3339 with Z or offset)
data.reserve_evidence: Dated reserve evidence (fixed during this version)
data.charge_limit_kw: Verified aggregate AC battery charge limit (kW)
data.loss_evidence: Calibration dates, method, meter boundaries and uncertainty

tariffs.title: Verified tariff activations
tariffs.description: Leave [] until effective dates are evidenced. Templates: flux_import, prime_export, flux_export_planned. Replacement is NOT active by default. Enter a JSON array of objects with template, effective_from (RFC3339 with offset), evidence, and optionally effective_to. Example shape only: {"template":"flux_import","effective_from":"DATED_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED","evidence":"Supplier confirmation reference"}. Import and export need separate records. No today's-rate retrospective substitution. Activations are append-only; retain old entries. A later effective version supersedes an earlier open-ended one.

sources.title: Matched cumulative telemetry
sources.description: Changing sources breaks coverage; never join unrelated cumulative meters. All energy sources require Wh, kWh or MWh. Freshness and timestamp skew are checked.

error.invalid_evidence: Invalid evidence: use finite nonnegative rates, valid ranges and a timezone-aware effective timestamp. Limits/capacity must be positive; efficiencies >0 and <=1.
error.invalid_tariffs: Invalid rate, missing evidence, conflicting correction, or ambiguous/nonexistent London clock time. Rates must be finite with explicit currency units; export standing must be zero. Edit the latest existing record for a same-date correction.

abort.backend_unavailable: Finance backend is not loaded. Load the integration before editing its ledger.
